scope: 36 scheduled arm-masked QCH/Need packets; no gold, future tool output or full-document audit.
limits: Not perfectly blind: reviewer knows prompts and prior E0/v1 cases; progress logs exposed arm identifiers and the single length-failure arm. Deterministic masking can also be reconstructed. No independent second reviewer.
ambiguity: Medium/high judgments are preserved, with permissive sensitivity to be computed after the immutable primary review. No case label will be changed after arm unmasking.
